summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a Q1 2026 interim dividend of $0.3906 per ordinary share and the commencement of a share buyback program. The dividend is payable on June 29, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of May 22, 2026 for ADSs and May 21, 2026 for ordinary shares. Shareholders may elect to receive dividends in USD, EUR, or GBP. The buyback details are referenced but not quantified in this filing. This represents routine capital return to shareholders via dividends and buybacks, a form of capital return. What to watch: sustainability of buyback pace and cash flow generation.
